Done. All three functions are implemented and exported:

1. **formatBytes(n)** in util.js — formats byte counts as B, KB, MB, or GB with one decimal place
2. **slugify(title)** in text.js — converts titles to URL-safe slugs (lowercase, trim, spaces→dashes, strips non-alphanumeric)
3. **fetchUsers(baseUrl)** in api.js — fetches and logs the number of users from the API endpoint
